title: /harness/analytics
responsibility: Redirects the former console analytics address to the explorer.

outputs.name: load
outputs.description: The value load returns, which is undefined because its body has no return statement. It only matters if load completes, and it never does because redirect(308, '/harness') throws on every call.

errors.name: Redirect 308
errors.description: A redirect thrown by redirect(308, '/harness') on every call to load, which sends the visitor to /harness with HTTP status 308 (Permanent Redirect). Because it is thrown unconditionally, load never returns a value.
